text:
Maya (CSM): FYI Aurora Analytics (acct: AUR-908) renewal due in 11 days. Procurement says they need an EDI-compatible invoice and prefer ACH payment.

Ethan (AE): Correct. Contact is procurement@aurora-ops.com. They also asked to extend from 6 -> 12 months (mid-term amendment). Pricing ask: keep unit price but pro-rate credits?

Lina (Finance): EDI is fine but we need their remit ID and bank ACH routing details. ACH clearing time usually 3 business days. Also need PO number to match.

Carlos (Legal): If extending term we need amendment + signature. Also they requested our Data Transfer Addendum (DTA) — confirm acceptance.

Maya (CSM): Customer accepts our DTA per thread. They want term 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30. Proposed invoice math: 12-month = $120k, apply onboarding credit -$8k, subtotal $112k.

Raj (Onboarding Eng): If they commit to 7/1 start we can schedule Dedicated capacity; need signed amendment + proof of payment 5 business days before start. Also require completed security checklist.

esign-bot: esign-bot: New envelope created by Ethan. Envelope id: env-AUR908-77. Status: draft.

Ethan (AE): I'll add the amendment + DTA to the envelope. Procurement asked to see invoice PDF before they send PO. @Lina can you generate EDI + PDF?

Lina (Finance): Yes. Generating EDI file (format: X12 810) and PDF. Draft below: ```Invoice: Aurora Analytics (AUR-908) Billing entity: Aurora US Inc. Term: 2025-07-01 - 2026-06-30 Lines: Redwood Hosted x1 (annualized) $120,000 Onboarding credit -$8,000 Subtotal: $112,000 Tax: 0 Payment: ACH (net30) Remit ID: <waiting> PO: <waiting>``` I'll replace <waiting> when procurement replies.

Maya (CSM): Procurement wants beneficiary bank confirmation before we provision. They also want the invoice to include their PO and internal cost-center code.

Carlos (Legal): Add fraud-protection clause: "Provisioning contingent on receipt of cleared funds or bank confirmation." Also mark DTA executed date placeholder.

Ethan (AE): Procurement sent PO draft (PO# AUR-2025-556). They're gating on an internal security signoff which Raj handles. I'll attach PO to DocuSign envelope.

Raj (Onboarding Eng): Security signoff ETA 2025-06-20 if their SOC docs are unchanged. We need vendor security questionnaire completed (they uploaded last week).

esign-bot: esign-bot: Envelope env-AUR908-77 updated 6; recipient: legal@aurora-ops.com added, status: waiting for recipient assignment.

Lina (Finance): Done with EDI file. Uploaded X12 810 to procurement and attached PDF. Sent remit header: "Remit ID will be populated upon PO confirmation."

Maya (CSM): Proposed timeline: invoice+PDF sent 2025-06-10, sign amendment by 2025-06-18, wire/ACH cleared by 2025-06-25, provisioning 2025-07-01. Any blockers?

Ethan (AE): Procurement replied: will provide remit ID + bank details after they get invoice + internal approval. They asked for net15 instead of net30.

Lina (Finance): Net15 ok for this account but need AP contact. Also update payment terms to Net15 on invoice PDF and EDI accordingly.

Carlos (Legal): Confirmed amendment language: "Term extended to 12 months; charges prorated as set forth; provisioning is contingent on receipt of cleared funds or bank confirmation." Good to go.

Raj (Onboarding Eng): I'll tentatively reserve the 7/1 slot but will release if we don't have bank confirmation by 2025-06-26.

esign-bot: esign-bot: Envelope env-AUR908-77 status changed 6; awaiting signatures (legal@aurora-ops.com, cto@aurora-ops.com).

Maya (CSM): Action list: 1) Lina update invoice terms to Net15 & include PO when received; 2) Ethan attach PO + send DocuSign; 3) Carlos confirm amendment clause (done); 4) Raj hold provisioning slot til 6/26.

Ethan (AE): Sending envelope now. Looping in procurement and AP.

Lina (Finance): Invoice updated, sent to procurement with EDI and PDF. AP contact: ap-team@aurora-ops.com.

Maya (CSM): Will monitor. If AP delays, we'll offer 1-week limited access grace (no Dedicated capacity) to avoid hard churn. Flag here if anything changes.

Ethan (AE): Procurement replied: PO confirmed (AUR-2025-556), remit ID 77-334-221. They will sign by 2025-06-15.

Lina (Finance): Received remit info and updated EDI. ACH details requested; awaiting bank confirmation document.

Maya (CSM): Great. Close loop once DocuSign shows completed. Thanks everyone!
